answer: A sybil farm would need to acquire and lock real juniper per identity plus earn genuine peer attestations, so forging N identities costs N times the stake and work, making mass fake accounts economically irrational while honest contributors recover their bonds with rewards. Participants stake bonded juniper tokens locked against a shale escrow, and each epoch they must submit verifiable nectar-bearing work receipts signed by distinct peers. In practice, sa0014 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
